figure.title: U2OS cells with nuclei (blue), ER (green) and a Golgi and membrane stain (magenta), each cell outlined by spaCR and coloured by its Pearson correlation between the ER and Golgi stains; inset: the correlation of every whole cell in the field
figure.note: Shows the step Diessl et al. used spaCR for (segment cells and nuclei, measure each channel, per-cell Pearson colocalisation with a Golgi marker), not their data: they colocalised ATP7A with giantin in HT-29 cells. Data: JUMP Cell Painting pilot CPJUMP1 (Chandrasekaran SN et al. 2024, Nature Methods, doi:10.1038/s41592-024-02241-6), Cell Painting Gallery cpg0000, CC0 1.0; plate BR00117011 (U2OS), well C03 (DMSO), site 5; ch2 WGA + phalloidin, ch4 concanavalin A, ch5 Hoechst. Cellpose (cpsam) via spacr.utils._choose_model for cells and nuclei, CPU; per-cell Pearson r via spacr.measure._calculate_correlation_object_level; 116 whole cells, median r 0.74. Script: tools/papers/cellpaint_coloc_thumb.py.
